decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity builds directly on the firm's core fibre and transport network knowledge, so the firm can read market feedback well and improve the service, and its promotion to the home page in 2019 signals strategic importance.

The number ordering portal draws on the firm's established voice wholesale and provisioning know-how and is cheap to maintain, but its sister voice products E and F were withdrawn and legacy voice is declining, so there is a moderate risk it will be discontinued.
